# MMMXCIX Quant

> A free, browser-based quantitative-trading toolkit: backtesting with honest
> statistics, live market charts, cross-asset data, a research engine, and a
> live world-events map. Everything runs client-side — no data leaves the
> browser — and every metric is shown against its naive baseline, so the tool
> says plainly when an "edge" is really just noise.

MMMXCIX Quant (quant.mmmxcix.com) is built for retail quants, traders, and
learners who want professional-grade methods without a Bloomberg terminal. It
is educational and explicitly not investment advice.

## What it does

- **Backtesting** — test strategies on real history with fees, slippage, and
  out-of-sample / walk-forward validation. Reports the Deflated Sharpe Ratio to
  penalise multiple testing, so overfit strategies are flagged, not celebrated.
- **ML Studio** — in-browser machine learning (scikit-learn via WASM):
  next-bar forecasting, cross-sectional ranking with rank IC and decile
  (Alphalens-style) quantile analysis, and triple-barrier labeling with
  meta-labeling and purged, embargoed walk-forward cross-validation (the López
  de Prado / Stefan Jansen methods).
- **Screener & correlation** — scan markets, a cross-asset correlation matrix,
  and a pairs mean-reversion tool (Kalman/OLS hedge ratio + Ornstein-Uhlenbeck
  half-life) that rejects non-cointegrated pairs.
- **Portfolio** — a simulated book with realized P/L plus a Hierarchical Risk
  Parity (HRP) suggested allocation.
- **Charts & indicators** — live crypto, stocks, ETFs and FX with drawing tools.
- **Macro & bond yields** — global yield curves and inversion signals.
- **World map / monitor** — a live map of ships (AIS), aircraft (ADS-B),
  satellites (SGP4), earthquakes, NASA FIRMS fires, GDACS disasters, UCDP
  conflict events, power/pipeline/mine/offshore infrastructure, submarine
  cables, GPS-interference zones, World Bank projects, and per-country
  instability signals. Click any country for its conflicts, hazards and news.
- **News digest** — a personalised daily market-news email (double opt-in).
- **Learn** — an academy, a strategy guide, and a reference of 30+ quant
  formulas.

## Design principles

- Honest by default: metrics carry baselines and significance tests; the tool
  states when a result is indistinguishable from chance.
- Free and private: computation is client-side; no account is required to use
  the core tools.
- Educational only — not financial, investment, legal, or tax advice.
